climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
land: Faces the midday sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune appellation within Aloxe-Corton for white wine from Chardonnay, with Pinot Blanc also allowed. Its vineyards lie in the villages of Aloxe-Corton and Pernand-Vergelesses. Aloxe-Corton itself uses Pinot Noir for red and Chardonnay for white.
